properties.decision:
UNDECIDED — RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Anthony, 2026-08-16.

⚠️ THIS NODE'S FIRST VERSION WAS WRONG AND IS CORRECTED HERE. It said reflow2 has "no SEQUENCE or GATE" and offered "stay a vocabulary and a set of detectors" as the status quo. BOTH ARE FALSE, and I wrote them before reading the skills. Corrected the same day, on the same question.

⭐ WHAT THE GUIDED PATHS ACTUALLY DO, quoted rather than characterised:
GENESIS enforces exactly the predecessor's order and uses its own labels: "Seed the brief into P0/P1 — and stop there … `add_requirement` for each thing that must be true (P0) … `add_capability` for each thing the system does (P1) … **Do NOT create Components (P2) yet.** Leaving structure unspecified is deliberate: the first DETECT round will surface `concept_without_design`, which is the right next question ('how should this be structured?'). Answer it *with the user*, not by guessing." The detector is real (`GapSource::ConceptWithoutDesign`). It also sets `mode` (`flexible` = design evolves with the build; `rigid` = design is the source of truth) at scaffold time — the predecessor's dial, with the predecessor's meaning, at the moment it matters.
ADOPT is stricter and is the path a brownfield user takes. Five phases — Gather, Scan, Analyze (static then dynamic), Recover, Validate — and its central discipline is the SE one that matters most: "NEVER INFER A REQUIREMENT FROM THE IMPLEMENTATION THAT SATISFIES IT. A requirement backed out of the code is satisfied by construction — it can never contradict anything, so a graph of those can never say anything." It demands BOTH SIDES OF EVERY CONTRACT, keeps recovered requirements at `proposed` until the user's word, and closes with `coverage_report` to say what the design has never heard of.

⇒ REFLOW2 IS NOT A BARE VOCABULARY. It ships a sequenced, opinionated process on both the greenfield and brownfield paths, and the sequence is function-before-structure.

WHY THE SELF-HOST IS NOT EVIDENCE AGAINST IT: reflow2 has no genesis epoch from a brief and was never taken through adopt. Its graph records organic growth with good bookkeeping — not a guided design. THE EXPERIMENT ANTHONY IS WORRIED ABOUT HAS NOT BEEN RUN ON REFLOW2 ITSELF. (And its functional decomposition WAS deliberate — `dec:bl83a-functional-decomposition`, accepted 2026-07-23, derived with the user.)

⚠️ THE ONE PLACE THE SELF-HOST IS A FAIR INDICTMENT, and it is narrower than "no process": reflow2's own graph VIOLATES ADOPT'S OWN INSTRUCTION. "Both sides of every contract" — and there are 73 coupled module pairs with ZERO declared interfaces.

THE QUESTION THAT REMAINS, and it is Anthony's real one restated: HOW DOES A USER GAIN CONFIDENCE THAT THE PROCESS WAS FOLLOWED? Nothing today records which skill a session used, at which phase, or reports when a design departed from the sequence.

THE OPTIONS, revised:
(a) NOTHING FURTHER. The guidance is good and the field reports support it — music_graph's own wins list says "coverage_report is the single best thing in the adopt flow" and "unmotivated_capability IS the design-recovery engine, exactly as the skill claims". AGAINST: it leaves confidence resting on testimony rather than on anything the graph can show.
(b) MAKE THE DESIGN SAY WHICH PROCESS PRODUCED IT — record the skill and phase a session worked in, so "was he guided" becomes a fact rather than a hope. Cheap. AGAINST: it records the claim, not the conformance; a session can say `adopt` and do anything.
(c) REPORT DEPARTURES FROM THE SEQUENCE — "Components exist but no Capabilities", "allocated before anything was decomposed", "this boundary has no contract". Every input is already computed, and it is the house style (`dec:report-dont-judge`). AGAINST: `undeclared_seam` has reported reflow2's own missing contracts all along, at severity 0.45, under the gate — a report nobody must act on is how the self-host drifted.
(d) THE REAL EXPOSURE MAY BE NEITHER: skills are SERVED but must be REACHED FOR. `req:skill-use-survives-a-long-session` is ACCEPTED and says the user must never be the trigger — and it is NOT BUILT. The risk to a new user is not a flawed process; it is a session that never loads `adopt` and starts writing Components on day one.

NOT ESTABLISHED: whether (d) is the dominant risk. Nobody has measured how often a consumer session actually invokes a skill.
properties.name: OPEN — reflow2's GUIDED paths do sequence function before structure; the open question is whether anything makes a design SHOW it followed one
properties.rationale: Recorded as brainstorming on Anthony's `/brainstorm`, 2026-08-16, and CORRECTED the same day after reading the genesis and adopt skills — the first version asserted reflow2 had no process, which was my error from not reading before characterising. His question and framing throughout; the measurements and the correction are mine. The self-host half is `dec:idea-should-reflow2s-own-design-be-re-derived-through-a-principled-se-process`. Nothing is promoted; that is his word.
